description: Set `prPriority` so that when the open PR limit is hit, packages owned by [Sanity](https://www.sanity.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ecosystem-renovate-preset) and the third-party packages we bump the most are opened first, followed by `dependencies`, `devDependencies`, and lastly GitHub Actions. Opt out with `ignorePresets`.
